walletDesign.title: Wallet pass design
walletDesign.upgradeNudge: Customizing pass fields is a paid feature — tap to upgrade.
walletDesign.locked: Upgrade your plan to customize the wallet pass.
walletDesign.layoutNote: Apple fixes the layout: each field sits in one region and, within a region, fields read left→right in the order below. Use ↑ ↓ to reorder; the preview shows exactly where each lands.
walletDesign.warnCount: This many fields may overflow — Apple shows about {{max}} comfortably here.
walletDesign.warnLong: Some text is long and may be cut off on the pass.
walletDesign.stripHint: Upload an empty and a filled icon to build the stamp strip from your own artwork.
walletDesign.googleStampHeroHint: Show the stamp grid in the Google banner and refresh it on every stamp (Google has no strip like Apple).
walletDesign.label: Label
walletDesign.stripArtworkHint: A photo behind the stamps. Cropped to fill the strip (Apple) and the banner (Google) — use a wide image for best results.

walletTemplates.lockedNote: This template locks the field layout. You can edit only colors, the stamp icons (or bottom image), and text — positions stay fixed.
walletTemplates.bottomImageHint: Full-width image shown in the strip (Apple) / hero (Google).

designer.collectBirthdayHint: Adds a birthday field to this card's join form. Edit the rest of that form on the Enroll page.
designer.singleUseHint: The card expires from the customer's wallet once the reward is redeemed (instead of resetting to keep collecting).
designer.referralHint: Customers get a share link after joining; when a friend joins through it, both earn a bonus stamp.
designer.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
designer.reprovisionWarning: Editing a published card re-provisions existing holders' passes.
designer.stampLayoutHint: Only changes cards with more than 5 stamps, where they wrap onto two rows.
designer.stampUploadHint: Or upload your own empty + filled stamp images.
designer.stampSaveFailed: Card saved, but the stamp style couldn't be applied.
designer.birthdaySaveFailed: Card saved, but the birthday setting couldn't be applied.
